newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial sees Aug 28 meeting on merger.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial sees Aug 28 meeting on merger.

text.p: Standard Financial Inc said Wednesday it expects to hold a special meeting on August 28 for shareholders to vote on its proposed merger with TCF Financial Corp.
In March, TCF and Standard Financial said they signed a definitive merger agreement under which TCF would acquire Standard Financial in a $424 million deal.
"Our proposed merger with TCF Financial is proceeding smoothly," David Mackiewich, Standard Financial chairman, said in a statement.
He added that the transaction is expected to close in the third quarter.
Standard Financial had total assets of $2.6 billion as of June 30. Earlier, it reported net income of $0.31 a primary share, up from $0.25 a year ago.
